profile: Cloud and enterprise architect with an MSc in Business Information Technology (Beispiel-Hochschule) and over six years in IT consulting and enterprise architecture. I know Azure adoption from both sides: delivering it as a consultant and shaping it as an architect at a Microsoft enterprise customer. At Globex Consulting I advised clients in several industries on cloud transformation and was deputy to the delivery lead. Native German speaker, fluent in English.

letter.subject: Application: Customer Success Account Manager (job number NS-2317)
attention: I have seen Azure adoption from both sides of the table. At Globex Consulting I helped deliver a global migration of more than 1,000 servers to Azure; at Beispiel Kantonalbank, as an ICT architect, I advised the CIO boards that decided, funded and governed the move to the cloud. As a Customer Success Account Manager, I want to bring both perspectives to your customers.
interest: Swiss enterprises in regulated industries decide on Azure the way Beispiel Kantonalbank did: through architecture reviews, business cases and CIO boards. I know that path from the inside, and I would like to help Nimbus Software's customers go down it faster, from cloud adoption to AI.

points: Trusted advice at board level: I have advised CIO boards and know what they weigh, from business priorities to procurement. I would use this to tie each customer's technology investments to the goals their leadership has set.

Success plans with measurable value: as an architect I backed cloud decisions with business cases and dashboards. I would build Customer Success Plans the same way, with shared objectives and success measures that the customer's governance can track.

Risks and dependencies: Azure migrations at Globex Consulting showed me where adoption stalls, from identity to operating models. I would raise these risks early and agree with the customer and the account team on who owns them.
Nimbus depth: the Azure Solutions Architect certification (AZ-305), and I know the Azure service catalogue from the customer's point of view.

action: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I would lead Customer Success Planning for your customers in Switzerland.
